name: feedback
description: Record a human thumbs-up or thumbs-down on a turn. This never enters the model prompt. Recording the same rating of the same turn twice stores one row (a double click, a replayed fetch or a retried POST is a no-op); the opposite rating is a second row. Input: {"rating":"up"|"down","session":"...","turn":N,"note":"..."} or {"list":true}.
llm_description: Record operator feedback (up/down) on a turn. Never injected into the model. Input: {rating, session?, turn?, note?} or {list:true}.
